review.brief: Review the diff of commit 6514968 only — not the whole module. Validate: (1) boundaries — only internal/analytics touched, no cmd/ change, no other module; (2) code-comment rule — no design.md, decision-ID, change-ID or tier citation in any comment this change wrote, INCLUDING the three constructor doc comments the leader rewrote; (3) every decorator implements its interface EXPLICITLY, never by embedding, with a compile-time assertion each; (4) the log lines match design.md D4's table exactly — format string, argument order, and whether the method logs before or after delegating; (5) D1 — only ConsumedByDay logs on Reader; the other three are silent pass-throughs. Logging them would be a Performance-Profile regression, not an improvement; (6) D6 — no decorator inspects, retries, or transforms a result or error; (7) wiring is inside the module's own constructors so cmd/poller and cmd/web need no change; (8) tasks.md coverage; (9) no test file added — RD1 excludes tests, so a missing test is NOT a finding; (10) anti-gaming: no criterion weakened, no self-approved status. Signals: go build ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l . and make lint were ASSISTANT-run and all clean (lint 0 issues). make test was USER-run and reported passing by the user. Judge test quality by reading, never by running.

rounds.notes: Reviewed commit 6514968 only. Boundaries clean: only internal/analytics/ files changed (analytics.go, query_log.go, reader.go, recalculate.go) plus this change's own openspec artifacts. No added/changed comment cites design.md, a decision ID, a change/roadmap ID, or a tier number -- checked query_log.go and the three rewritten constructor doc comments (NewGapWriter, NewReader, NewRecalculator); each old citation was replaced with a true, useful sentence about the wrapping. All three decorators implement their port explicitly, no embedding, each with its own var _ Iface = (*logging...)(nil) assertion. Verified D4 table field by field against the real signatures in analytics.go/reader.go: ConsumedByDay logs AFTER delegating with tesla_id/start/end/rows/flagged in that exact order; Recalculate and Reconcile log BEFORE delegating with the exact args; ReconcileWindow logs BEFORE delegating, and gap_writer.go confirms its pre-transaction validation runs inside inner.ReconcileWindow, so the log line still appears even when that validation later rejects the call, matching D4. D1 respected: only ConsumedByDay logs; OdometerDeltaByDay/BatteryLevelByDay/LatestMetricsForVehicles are silent pass-throughs with matching real signatures. D6 respected: every decorator logs then returns inner's result/error unchanged; the flaggedCount loop only reads the result, never mutates it. Wiring lives only inside the three constructors; confirmed cmd/poller/main.go and cmd/web/main.go call them directly and needed no edit, and none was made. tasks.md: all 7 tasks checked off; progress.json records each at awaiting-user-verification, which is honest (make test was user-run, not assistant-run). No test file, matching RD1 -- not a finding. Anti-gaming: no task/criterion text altered beyond the checkbox. Independently re-ran go build ./..., go vet ./internal/analytics/..., gofmt -l internal/analytics/, and make lint -- all clean, matching the reported signals.
